name: mf-vs-monolith
description: Master's thesis research platform: micro-frontends vs monolith (same marketplace, two architectures, live comparison lab)

scripts.build:remotes: npm run build -w mf/catalog -w mf/checkout -w mf/reviews
scripts.serve:remotes: concurrently -n catalog,checkout,reviews -c blue,magenta,green "npm run preview -w mf/catalog" "npm run preview -w mf/checkout" "npm run preview -w mf/reviews"
scripts.start: npm run build:remotes && concurrently -k -n remotes,shell,monolith,defense -c gray,cyan,yellow,green "npm run serve:remotes" "npm run dev -w mf/shell" "npm run dev -w monolith" "npm run dev -w defense"
scripts.start:lab: npm run build:remotes && concurrently -k -n remotes,shell,monolith,lab -c gray,cyan,yellow,green "npm run serve:remotes" "npm run dev -w mf/shell" "npm run dev -w monolith" "npm run dev -w lab"
